Subject: KeenHealth - Premium support + Onboarding package (exec approval needed)

Hi team,

KeenHealth (Jordan Meyers) is asking for a bundled commercial that includes:
- 12-month Redwood Premium Support (24/7 SLA, dedicated TAM)
- 6-week onboarding with custom integration to their EHR via partner IntegrateWorks
- A set of 40 dev hours for connector work + 8 hours of go-live support

Summary of ask: customer needs a commercial concession to close this quarter. They're requesting a 30% one-time onboarding credit and 15% off recurring for year 1 to cover the additional integration scope. Attached: SOW (KeenHealth_SOW_v1.3.xlsx) and a proposed redline (KeenHealth_Contract_Redline_v3.pdf). Sam Park from IntegrateWorks is on the thread for scope confirmation.

Why I think we should entertain: this is a strategic health-tech account (pilot to enterprise) with clear expansion upside; deal sits at $420k ARR list if we keep standard pricing. With requested concessions, ACV would be lower but we retain logo and expansion potential into two enterprise hospitals.

Ask: need executive sign-off for non-standard discount and to include the onboarding hours in the commercial. Can we get a decision by end-of-day Friday (Aug 21)?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett

+1 415-555-0134

Thanks for the summary. A few data points I need before I can support escalation:

2) Onboarding hours: confirm which hours are billable vs credit. If we’re crediting 40 dev hours, that needs to be absorbed in fiscal calculations.
3) Risks/ops: will Premium include the TAM commitment you mention or a reduced SLO?

- One-time onboarding credit: 30% off onboarding fees (applied as credit across milestone invoices)
- Recurring discount: 15% off subscription for the first 12 months
- Include 40 dev hours as part of onboarding (no additional charge) and 8 hours go-live support

If approved, I will: 1) update redline with the clawback language Rishi suggested, 2) send DocuSign link to procurement, and 3) inform Finance for revenue recognition schedule.

Laura / Marissa —

I reviewed the proposed concession and the SOW. Approve with the following conditions:
1) Include a measurable SLO table in the SOW: P1 response < 1 hour, P2 < 4 hours, weekly TAM touchpoint
2) Cap the refundable dev-hours credit at 40 hours (no excess) and require sign-off on acceptance test plan before go-live
3) Add a 12-month clawback clause if the customer terminates within 9 months (pro-rata reversal of onboarding credit)
4) Finance (Karthish) to confirm margin and revenue recognition schedule before DocuSign.

If Rishi/Karthish confirm margin >= 40% post-concession and Legal is satisfied with redline, proceed to DocuSign. Please submit final DocuSign by Aug 25 to meet their procurement timeline.
